One commit-model --zk (T = 32, P = 8, byte 4): 66.00 s, peak RSS 31.71 GB. Three proofs against it, indices 0, 1, 2, each verified with --expect-model: prove-dev --zk 516.71 s, 592.69 s, 658.14 s (median 592.69 s, index 1, this record); peak RSS 33.96, 30.47, 30.81 GB; verify-dev 32.48 s, 32.70 s, 33.55 s; proof bytes 21,411,006 in every run (fresh per-proof seeds). Other agents shared the host: 1-minute load average 5.3 to 23 sampled before the steps (load.log), so the wall times are upper bounds. T = 64 did not fit this 48 GB host (prove killed at about 31 GB RSS with heavy paging, twice); a larger host was not available (Vast.ai account out of credit). The window is the E16-11 prompt (24 tokens) greedily extended to T = 32, checked 23..32, y = 2654; the same tokens as the T = 64 development runs.
